name: ticket
title: Ticket
description: A sheet with a tear line: a pass, a coupon, a receipt and its stub.
use: Something a person holds and hands over: a boarding pass, an event ticket, a voucher, a receipt. The stub carries what is checked or torn off: a code, a seat, a price. It is a material like a card, and what stands on it is yours.

instead.when: The content is not something handed over or redeemed
It is one fact with a status in the flow of the page

platform.fallback: The two faces meet square, without the half-round notches; the perforation alone parts them

classes.name: ticket
classes.description: The sheet: a body over a stub, on a perforation between two notches

classes.name: ticket-row
classes.description: The stub at the end of the body instead of under it, as a coupon has it

classes.name: ticket-body
classes.description: What the ticket is for: a raised face with 20px of padding that takes the room the stub leaves

classes.name: ticket-stub
classes.description: What is checked or torn off, beyond the perforation

properties.name: --ticket-notch
properties.description: Radius of the notch at each end of the tear line

properties.name: --ticket-padding
properties.description: Padding of the body and the stub

example:
Taipei to Tokyo, 12 November
Seat 14A
